title: Sea Dweller
meta_description: Sea Dweller is a 4BR 30A retreat near Inlet Beach with rooftop hot tub, Gulf views, bikes, communal pool, grill, and balconies.
description_expanded:
Sea Dweller is the kind of 30A getaway where the rhythm of the Gulf is never far off --- you'll hear it from the rooftop, where a private hot tub and gas grill turn sunsets into the main event. Set in Twin Palms just steps from Inlet Beach, this modern four-bedroom retreat was built for families and friend groups who want the polish of a high-end home with the ease of leaving the car parked all week.
⠀
Inside, four bedrooms (including a king ensuite and a bunk room built for the kids) sleep eleven across thoughtfully designed spaces. Smart TVs, a fully stocked kitchen, and a coffee setup with both pods and drip mean mornings move at your pace. Balconies on every floor invite the breeze in, and a main-floor bedroom keeps things accessible for grandparents or anyone skipping the stairs.
⠀
Outside is where Sea Dweller really leans into the 30A lifestyle. Two bikes are yours for the week---perfect for cruising to dinner, weaving through Rosemary Beach's cobblestone streets, or making the short ride to Alys Beach for ice cream and people-watching. Guests also have access to a communal pool, adding another easy way to cool off between beach trips. The Donut Hole is a two-minute roll away for breakfast, and 30Avenue's restaurants, boutiques, and yoga studio are practically next door.
⠀
When it's beach time, Inlet Beach is the move---wide, open sand with parking, restrooms, showers, and ramp access with no stairs. Multiple public access points sit about two blocks from the home, or you can drive down Pinewood Lane to Orange Street, cross over 98, and be right by the sand. The hardest decision of the day might be whether to stay put on the rooftop or chase the sunset down the shoreline.

BEACH ACCESS: Inlet Beach is one of 30A's best beaches, with space to spread out plus convenient amenities like parking, bathrooms, and showers. It also offers easy ramp access with no stairs to climb. Multiple access points are about two blocks from the home, or you can drive down Pinewood Lane, turn onto Orange Street, cross over 98, and head straight for the sand.

ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 11
• Bedroom 1 - 1 Queen, hallway bath
• Bedroom 2 -- 1 Queen, ensuite
• Bunk Room -- 1 Twin/Full \& 1 Twin/Twin, shared bath
• Bedroom 4 -- 1 King, ensuite

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Private Rooftop Spa and Lounge area with Gulf Views as well as a gas grill
• 2 Bikes
• Bedroom on Main
• Balcony on every floor
• Smart TVs
• Coffee Maker -- pods and drip
• Washer/Dryer
• Self-Check in
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash clothes, etc
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2-3 parking spaces.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
